explication: pypdf is a Python PDF library. The principal workflow opens a PDF with PdfReader, exposes pages and document objects, then supports page-level inspection such as text extraction; PdfWriter creates or modifies PDFs for output. The README also documents merging, splitting, page transformations, metadata, annotations, and encryption. The tree and excerpts establish the main modules, but most reader/writer wiring is unsampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
